proves.claim: parseSpec reads stakes low, team or critical into row.stakes, gives team when none is written, and reports any other value as a row problem.

spec.logic-grammar.stakes-field.why: Without it, a row could not say how much a wrong approval costs, and a typo would pass unseen.

proves.claim: a row without stakes parses its gate, serves and signers as before.

spec.logic-grammar.stakes-keeps-others.why: Without it, adding the field could change how every existing row reads.

proves.claim: spec draft appends a draft row with the printed id and leaves existing rows untouched.

spec.draft.appends-row.why: Draft rows must never reuse an id or disturb approved rows.

proves.claim: spec draft refuses with a next step and prints no id when the spec file cannot be written.

spec.draft.refuses-unwritable.why: An id printed for a row that was never written would be cited by work that has no row.

proves.claim: canonical text fixes the field order per record type and defaults the note.

spec.signature.canonical-field-order.why: A signature over loosely ordered text could verify on one machine and fail on another.

proves.claim: a signature verifies for the listed key and fails once the signed text or note changes.

spec.signature.verifies-listed-key.why: A sign-off must break when the row it approved is edited afterwards.

proves.claim: a signature never verifies against another key or an unlisted label.

spec.signature.rejects-other-key.why: Only the listed principal's key may approve a row.

proves.claim: a principal is listed by an uncommented line, alone or among comma-separated names.

spec.signature.principal-listing.why: A commented-out key must not keep approving.

proves.claim: every spec-cell test registered here has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

spec.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: every spec test file that reads files opens with an input header naming the cells it reads.

spec.inputs.declared.why: Affected-test selection can only see a reader that declares what it reads.

proves.claim: with the outside-src rule on, the reader rule reports no spec test file.

spec.inputs.rule-clean.why: The declared-inputs rule must stay clean in this cell once it is turned on.

proves.claim: the static imports of spec row apply reach neither the state barrel nor the state machine module.

spec.io-row-apply.never-reaches-state-ma.why: Status loads spec row apply, so a heavy state import there slows every status call.

proves.claim: frozenCriterion writes stakes on each frozen row whose stakes is low or critical, so a row raised from low to team or critical freezes to a different digest.

spec.io-main.frozen-rows-carry-stakes.why: Without it, the board would keep no record of the stakes an item was claimed under, and a forged lower stake could not be seen.

proves.claim: a row at team, written or by default, freezes to exactly the text and digest it froze to before stakes were recorded.

spec.io-main.team-rows-freeze-unchanged.why: Without it, every claimed item's frozen digest would change and read stale.

proves.claim: planRowApply appends a person's decision on a standard doctrine default to the repo doctrine file once and changes no other line.

spec.row-decisions.standard-apply-append.why: Without it, a decision on a standard default has no repo line to land in and is lost.

proves.claim: planRowApply makes no change when the same decision line is already there and refuses STALE_ROW_DECISION when a different row holds the id.

spec.row-decisions.standard-apply-stale.why: Without it, an apply could write a second line or overwrite a row the person never saw.

proves.claim: prepareRowDecisions records an approval of a standard doctrine default absent from the repo file as a standard row with an empty source and the injected port's line.

spec.row-decisions.standard-approve-reco.why: Without it, a person could not approve a standard default, which is refused NO_ROW today.

proves.claim: prepareRowDecisions records a decline of a standard doctrine default with its reason as the wont line.

spec.row-decisions.standard-decline-reco.why: Without it, declining a standard default would lose the person's reason.

proves.claim: an id that is neither a repo row nor a standard row, or a standard id without the port, still refuses NO_ROW.

spec.row-decisions.unknown-id-still-refu.why: Without it, a mistyped id could record a decision on no row.
